_note: Curated 'fundamental' subset of the central skills repo that THIS product ships by default. Read at every snapshot refresh, so editing it takes effect without restarting the backend. default-snapshot.mjs keeps a compiled-in fallback used only if this file is missing or invalid. NOTE the curated filter applies ONLY to the builtin kit — skills from other registered sources (e.g. the auto-system engine plugin) are copied in full, which is why the auto-system skills are not listed here.
_pipeline_note: The first six are the planning pipeline that llm_agent/runtime/plan-pipeline.mjs injects by id (brainstorming for Plan, grilling for Assist Plan, writing-plans on hand-off, executing-plans or subagent-driven-development to execute; assist-plan documents the sequence for the '/' menu). They MUST stay in this list: the pipeline resolves them through the user's enabled sources, and llm_default_sources is the always-on source every user has, so dropping one here silently degrades a planning mode to its bindings with no process attached.
